static_evidence: Read-only disassembly of the exact installed compiler whose stack was sampled. No binary modification.

observations.meaning: GenerateBitConcat entry; SysV arguments include ArrayRef pointer rsi, count rdx and target IntegerType pointer rcx.
Loop calls ConstantInt::get(Type*, offset, false). rdi is the cast result type, rsi/r12 the cumulative bit offset.
Zero-value test occurs after the shift offset ConstantInt has been requested.
ConstantInt::get(Context, APInt) accesses LLVMContext DenseMap<APInt,unique_ptr<ConstantInt>>, copies wide APInt key, and constructs ConstantInt.
IntegerType bitwidth is read as uint32 at type pointer+8, shifted right by8; >64 bits uses APInt::initSlowCase.

conditional_storage_model: For M distinct shift offsets expressed at W-bit width, dense APInt constant interning needs storage proportional to M*W bits, with separate key/value copies visible in the implementation. This is a conditional algorithmic model, not yet a measured production allocation total.

zero_control_static_order.meaning: The matching pointer-selection diagnostics occur in function conversion, after global generation in buildModule. The altered initializer control reached this later failure; HLSGen did not complete.
